summary: Microvast Holdings filed an 8-K reporting the departure of Chief Accounting Officer Eric N. Garcia and the conversion by CEO Yang Wu of the full $25M principal of a convertible loan into common stock. The loan, entered May 2024 and amended March 2025 with a May 28, 2026 maturity, was converted via notice on that date. No price per share, premium, or other deal terms were disclosed. The CAO departure is a routine officer change, and the loan conversion is a compensatory/balance-sheet event, not a special-situation tender or capital return.
